steps.en: Install the Claude Code plugin and supply a public research question
steps.zh: 安装 Claude Code 插件，提出公开研究问题

steps.en: Write required claims and map the field through two search approaches
steps.zh: 列出必要主张，用两种搜索路径绘制领域地图

steps.en: Follow sources, save accepted texts, and attach claim locations
steps.zh: 追索来源，保存合格原文，为主张标注位置

steps.en: Check extract text against saved lines and build a local reading page
steps.zh: 按已存行号核对摘录，生成本地阅读页

steps.en: Read original passages and decide which claims the evidence supports
steps.zh: 阅读原文，判断证据支持哪些主张

value.en: You get a traceable reading trail instead of an unexplained summary
value.zh: 拿到可追溯的原文阅读路径，而非无从判断的总结
